moodys.citation_text: Moody's held Northern Light at Ba1 negative entering 2020 (legacy from rebrand period). Outlook revised to positive in Jan 2022 while affirming Ba1.

sp.citation_text: S&P reaffirmed Northern Light at BBB stable in Jan 2022 — implies BBB was the held rating entering window.

fitch.citation_text: Northern Light not rated by Fitch.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's revised outlook from negative to positive; affirmed Ba1. Improved operating performance, CARES Act support, balance sheet stabilization.
S&P reaffirmed BBB with stable outlook in Jan 2022.

outcome_class_rationale: Northern Light Health held ratings flat with Moody's outlook revised UP from negative to positive in Jan 2022. Within-window signal was clearly improving. The 2023+ deterioration ($130M FY2022 loss, subsequent downgrades to Ba3) is OUT-OF-WINDOW — though the seeds were visible in the FY2022 loss that emerged in Feb 2023 reporting.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: Northern Light FY2020 patient revenue $1.54B (down $108M from $1.64B FY2019); total operating revenue ~$1.75B with CARES Act funding. Weak liquidity is structural at Ba1 rating level.
